title: Stabilize webview state, history, search, responses, and accessibility
description:
Make the webview resilient to reloads, rapid actions, large responses, and keyboard-only use. Persist safe editor/navigation state with VS Code webview state, distinguish saved from unsaved changes, and confirm before destructive navigation. Use protocol correlation so duplicate clicks, stale responses, and delayed history/search results cannot overwrite the active view. Keep Auth Builder state synchronized with the normalized request without placing secrets in webview persistence.

Make history deletion, clearing, filtering, and replay operate on stable IDs and show clear empty/error states. Global search must navigate to and load the selected request, not merely display a result. Render binary images only from exact base64 plus an allowlisted MIME type; bound JSON formatting and large-text rendering, and release object URLs/caches when responses change.

Add semantic labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus, predictable focus restoration, accessible dialogs/tabs, and status announcements. Smoke tests should cover reload, unsaved changes, double-send, out-of-order results, replay, search navigation, large/binary responses, and keyboard flows.

checklist.text: Persist safe editor/navigation state and warn before navigation or reload discards unsaved changes
Use operation/execution correlation to suppress duplicate submission and ignore stale results
Keep Auth Builder and request state synchronized while excluding credential values from persisted webview state
Repair history delete, clear, filter, and replay by stable ID with explicit empty/error feedback
Make global-search selection navigate to and load the exact collection/request result
Render bounded text/JSON and exact binary images safely, with allowlisted MIME types and cache cleanup
Add labels, keyboard behavior, focus management, accessible dialogs/tabs, and status announcements
Smoke-test reload, unsaved state, races, history, search, large/binary responses, and keyboard-only operation
